text: My chest feels tight, and I'm a little lightheaded.
I'm bleeding more than before. Could someone come?
The machine beside me keeps beeping. I'm not sure why.
Could you help me to the bathroom? I feel unsteady.
There's water on the floor by the bathroom.
I'm hungry, but I don't know if I'm allowed to eat yet.
Another blanket would be lovely, thank you.
我想要多一張被，好凍呀。
Me duele mucho la cabeza desde esta mañana.
